direct_growth_rationale: Q1 FY27 underlying volume grew 5% and sales 10%. Home care and beauty led growth while palm-cost pressure affected personal care. Forecast volume fades, pricing varies by scenario, and EBITDA margin is calibrated to 23.35% FY26 continuing operations.

research_notes.finding: FY26 total parent PAT includes ice-cream demerger effects. Use continuing parent PAT INR10633cr and operating EBITDA INR15054cr. The INR4611cr demerger gain is excluded from recurring forecasts.
research_notes.source: Annual report PDF419,445; annual result PDF8,12.

research_notes.finding: Continuing CFO is reconciled as total CFO less signed discontinued CFO: FY26 INR10999cr - (-72cr) = INR11071cr; FY25 INR11886cr - 94cr = INR11792cr. Total FY26 cash capex INR1361cr is not asserted as continuing-only capex. Forecast capex remains an explicit 1.8%-2.8% sales judgment. Group cash dividends paid were INR10124cr/FY26 and INR12473cr/FY25; these are not continuing-segment allocations.
research_notes.source: FY2026 annual report PDF370-371,446; annual result PDF11.

research_notes.finding: Deduct the INR618cr acquisition liability once. Other non-trade operating balances and pension settlement schedules are not fully projected. Core trade NWC is a narrow proxy.

Regular payout 91% in FY26 and 95% in FY25 supports a secondary multi-stage DDM. Forecast payout 85%-95%, with terminal payout constrained by sustainable ROE. Cash distributions are uniformly prorated, not an exact payment calendar.
